Name: Robin's Material Buy-out
Author: ceddieeee
Description:
[b]Stop running back to the farm for five pieces of Wood.[/b]

In vanilla Stardew Valley, if you are short by even a single Stone, Robin (or the [i]Wizard's[/i]) will refuse to start construction. This mod allows Robin to supply those missing materials herself for a fee.
[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]How it Works[/b][/size]
When you open the Carpenter (or magical) menu, the mod checks your inventory against the building's requirements.[list]
[*][b]If you have all the materials:[/b] Everything works exactly like the normal game.
[*][b]If you are missing materials:[/b]
[list]
[*]Robin calculates the cost of the missing items based on their current market value.
[*]The "Buy-out" cost is added to the standard building fee.
[*]You pay the [b]Grand Total[/b] in gold, and construction begins immediately.
[/list][/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
[b]1. The Information Board[/b]
A board appears next to the building menu showing:[list]
[*]Which materials you are missing and how many.
[*]The price for the missing supplies.
[*]The total construction fee.
[*]Red Text Warning: If the total price is more than you currently have in your funds.
[/list]
[b]2. Smart Pricing[/b]
The mod respects your progress. If you have professions (like [i]Blacksmith[/i]) that make materials more valuable, Robin adjusts her supply fees accordingly. You can also force the mod to use "Base Prices" in the settings.

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod is fully compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/url] You can easily tweak the rules from the main menu or in-game:
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod[/b] ([i]true[/i]): Enable or disable this mod.
[*][b]Display Info Board[/b] ([i]true[/i]): Show the material breakdown board next to the menu. If disabled, the cost breakdown appears in the "Build" button tooltip instead.
[*][b]Use Base Prices[/b] ([i]false[/i]): If enabled, materials always cost their base value. If disabled, costs adjust based on your professions.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url]﻿.
[*](Optional but highly recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to easily change your settings in game.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Delete the mod's folder from your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Known Bug[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]A visual glitch may briefly cause the build button to appear in its blocked state (semi-transparent) for a fraction of a second before switching to the valid state.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Support
[/b][/size]If this mod saves you a trip back to the farm, consider leaving an endorsement on the Nexus page. It goes a long way in helping others discover it. [b]Thank you for trying it out :)[/b]
